crossRefs.note: Yahweh said to Samuel, “Listen to the voice of the people in all that they tell you; for they have not rejected you…
But the people refused to listen to the voice of Samuel; and they said, “No; but we will have a king over us,
“When you saw that Nahash the king of the children of Ammon came against you, you said to me, ‘No, but a king shall…
Isn’t it wheat harvest today? I will call to Yahweh, that he may send thunder and rain; and you will know and see that…
“Speak to the children of Israel, and take rods from them, one for each fathers’ house, of all their princes according…
In the morning therefore you shall be brought near by your tribes. It shall be that the tribe which Yahweh selects…
But you, Bethlehem Ephrathah, being small among the clans of Judah, out of you one will come out to me that is to be…

translations.web: But you have today rejected your God, who himself saves you out of all your calamities and your distresses; and you have said to him, ‘No! Set a king over us.’ Now therefore present yourselves before Yahweh by your tribes, and by your thousands.”
translations.bsb: But today you have rejected your God, who saves you from all your troubles and afflictions, and you have said to Him, ‘No, set a king over us.’ Now therefore present yourselves before the LORD by your tribes and clans.”
translations.kjv: And ye have this day rejected your God, who himself saved you out of all your adversities and your tribulations; and ye have said unto him, Nay, but set a king over us. Now therefore present yourselves before the LORD by your tribes, and by your thousands.
translations.asv: but ye have this day rejected your God, who himself saveth you out of all your calamities and your distresses; and ye have said unto him, Nay, but set a king over us. Now therefore present yourselves before Jehovah by your tribes, and by your thousands.
